words.explanation: n. [C] a country, considered esp. in relation to its people and its social or economic structure 国家
n. [C] sb. who is good at sports or who often does sports 运动员
vi. to take part in a competition or sports event 参加比赛
words.example: How many runners are competing in the marathon?

words.explanation: v. ( sth. ~s the mind ) if sth. boggles the mind, it is so unusual that people find it hard to imagine or accept 使人无法想象；使人难以接受
words.example: How she ever got her success boggled his mind.

words.explanation: vt. to succeed in doing sth., esp. after trying very hard（尤指经过艰苦努力后）完成（任务），取得（成功）
words.example: Annie is very proud of what she's accomplished.

words.explanation: n. [C] sth. that sb. does that is impressive because it needs a lot of skill, strength, etc. 业绩；功绩；壮举
words.example: He performed a feat at the North Pole.

words.explanation: n. [C, U] the quality of trying to do sth. even when it is difficult 决心；坚定；毅力
words.example: Determination and hard work led Tom from poverty to success.

words.explanation: n. [sing.] the most successful, powerful, exciting, etc. part of sth. 极点；顶点；顶峰
words.example: By last year, Fenny had reached the pinnacle of her commercial success.

words.explanation: a. relating to athletics 运动的
words.example: Her athletic career was cut short by a knee injury.

words.explanation: n. [C] sth. important that you succeed in doing by your own efforts 成绩；成就
a. too strange to be believed or very difficult to believe 不可相信的；难以置信的
words.example: She earns an incredible amount of money.

words.explanation: a. forming the base from which everything else develops 基础的；基本的
words.example: Trust is foundational – you can accomplish wonders with it and very little without it.

words.explanation: n. [C, U] two or more different things, qualities, substances, etc. that are used or put together 结合；联合；混合
words.example: The police believed that a combination of bad weather and human error led to the accident.

words.explanation: n. [U] the hard work or effort that sb. puts into a particular activity because they care about it a lot 奉献，敬业（精神）
words.example: He was named "Man of the Year" for his dedication to community activities.

words.explanation: ad. at an unknown time in the future, esp. a long time in the future 将来会有一天；有朝一日
words.example: Maybe someday our grandchildren will want to read these books.

words.explanation: n. [C, U] a sudden clear understanding of sth., esp. sth. complicated（尤指对复杂事情的）顿悟，猛醒
words.example: His research has given us some insight into what causes the teenager to make a wrong choice.

words.explanation: n. [C] an idea of what you think sth. should be like 看法；观点；想象
words.example: Education and experience bring a breadth of vision and understanding to him.

words.explanation: n. [U] special attention that is given to one particular subject or situation （注意力的）集中点，中心点
words.example: This test reﬂects the focus of your mind on that particular thing.

words.explanation: ad. recently 近来；最近
words.example: This issue has been in my mind a lot lately.

words.explanation: v. to become less or make sth. less in range, difference, etc. 缩小…的范围（差距）
words.example: The police have narrowed down the list to 50 people.

words.explanation: ad. used when telling sb. the last thing at the end of a list or series of statements 最后（一点）
words.example: On speaking English I have three points to tell you: first, pronunciation; next, vocabulary; lastly, more practice.

words.explanation: n. [U] determination to keep trying to achieve sth. in spite of difficulties 不屈不挠；坚持不懈
words.example: This job cannot be done without the team's perseverance.

words.explanation: a. important and having a strong influence or effect（影响）深刻的，极大的
words.example: This is a scientifc discovery of profound inﬂuence.

words.explanation: vi. to continue trying to do sth. in a very determined way, in spite of difficulties 坚忍不拔；坚持不懈
words.example: Persevere until you reach your goal.

words.explanation: vt. to experience problems, difficulties, or opposition when you are trying to do sth. 遇到，遭到（问题、困难、反对）
words.example: His eﬀorts to establish the clinic encountered a number of setbacks.

words.explanation: v. ( quit , quit ) ( infml. ) to stop doing sth. 停止（做某事）
words.example: Winners never quit, and quitters never win.

words.explanation: vt. to try to persuade sb. to do sth. by making it seem attractive 怂恿，引诱（某人做某事）
words.example: The company is hoping a huge salary will tempt Andy to return as the team leader.

words.explanation: n. [U] ( BrE fulfilment ) the act or state of meeting a need, demand, or condition（需要、要求或条件的）实现，满足
words.example: The government should speed up the fulfillment of its promises.

words.explanation: v. if you combine two or more different things, ideas, or qualities or if they combine, they begin to exist or work together（使）结合；（使）组合；（使）综合
words.example: You should combine exercise with a healthy diet.

words.explanation: to agree to stop fighting 停止战斗
words.example: The terrorists were forced to lay down their arms.

words.word: set / put your mind to sth.
words.explanation: to decide you are going to do sth. and to put a lot of effort into doing it 决心要；一心想
words.example: If you'd just put your mind to work, I'm sure you could do it well.
words.phonetic: set  put your mind to sth..mp3

words.explanation: used when giving a reason to explain what you have just said 毕竟
words.example: After all, the worst the boss can do is say no if you ask him.

words.explanation: to reduce the amount, size, cost, etc. of sth. 削减；缩减
words.example: Do you have any suggestions for cutting back on fats in cooking?

words.explanation: if sb. or sth. moves to and fro, they move in one direction and then back again 来来往往地；往复地
words.example: A monkey ran to and fro, which made the children very happy.

words.explanation: to do sth. that needs to be organized and planned 实行；进行；执行
words.example: The teenagers carried out a survey on attitudes to exams.

words.word: be well on the / your way to (doing) sth.
words.explanation: to have nearly achieved sth. and be going to achieve it soon 即将达到；将要成就
words.example: We are well on the way to reaching our sales targets.
words.phonetic: be well on the  your way to (doing) sth..mp3
